messages:
ivy: Quick note: console shows a ton of 'closed' lines with no reason. Can we standardize a small close.code + close.reason for streaming sessions?

tom: Yes. Freeform strings are useless for alerts. Propose numeric codes (100..699) + short token reasons.

ravi: Agree. Also include tokens_emitted so billing can decide. Example: code=200 reason=proxy_204 tokens_emitted=0 trace=tr-9a

ops-bot: Deploy hook: router-canary v1 -> 3% (1799999999-ops)

zoe: UI: add a compact badge and a filter dropdown (reason:proxy_204, reason:client_timeout). Add tooltip whether billable. Gate behind flag `stream.close_v2`.

ivy: Action: tom implement code+reason; ravi add tokens_emitted; zoe add flag+badge. Revisit in 24h after canary metrics.
